The turning vehicle is executing a cut-in maneuver from the right (y=-3.5m) into the ego's lane (y=0.0m) starting at x=20.8m. Given the ego vehicle's speed of 50 kph (~13.9 m/s) and the turning vehicle's speed of 4.7 m/s, the ego vehicle will reach the conflict zone significantly faster than the turning vehicle can clear the lane. To avoid a collision, the ego vehicle must decelerate to yield to the merging vehicle.
